controls.name: leading-zero-canonical
controls.why: accept a leading zero as canonical ([0-9]\d* instead of 0|[1-9]\d*)

controls.name: sign-plus-canonical
controls.why: accept a leading plus sign as well as a minus
controls.find: if u.len() > 0 && u[0] == '-' { u.drop_first() } else { u }

controls.name: legacy-bool-spellings
controls.why: read the legacy spelling True as a boolean on the relationship path

controls.name: as-built-without-final-newline-match
controls.why: the as-built pattern with \Z instead of $ (no match before a final line break); the newline witness must fail

controls.name: as-built-ascii-digits
controls.why: the as-built pattern with re.ASCII (\d is [0-9]); the non-ASCII digit witness must fail
